name: Dress the Monster
title: Dress the Monster
subtitle: Accessible Shared Quiz Game
description: An accessible shared monster dress-up game for Squidly sessions with three host-selectable modes: Quiz (preset picture questions), Open (host asks anything, client answers verbally, in writing or by numbered choice, host marks it) and Free (tap to dress). Synchronized state, answer feedback, sounds, animations, reset and completion.
author: Joshua Aarons
